catalogueDoc.summary: nanoGPT is a small, readable codebase for training and finetuning GPT language models. It includes a character-level Shakespeare demo, a loader for OpenAI's GPT-2 weights, and scripts for sampling text and benchmarking.

routes.title: Train a tiny model on Shakespeare and read what it writes
routes.description: Downloads the 1MB Shakespeare text, trains a small character-level GPT on the CPU, then prints generated Shakespeare-like samples.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm

routes.title: Make the pretrained GPT-2 continue a sentence you give it
routes.description: Downloads OpenAI's small GPT-2 weights and prints several continuations of a prompt; the README example uses the 1.5B model, which is too large for this machine.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm
python sample.py --init_from=gpt2 --device=cpu --compile=False --start="What is the answer to life, the universe, and everything?" --num_samples=5 --max_new_tokens=100

routes.title: Measure how fast the model trains on your CPU
routes.description: Runs a stripped-down training loop on random data and prints the time taken per iteration.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm

routes.title: Finetune GPT-2 on Shakespeare and read the new samples
routes.description: Starts from a pretrained GPT-2 checkpoint and finetunes it on tiny Shakespeare, then samples from the result.
routes.reason: needs a GPU; the finetuning config starts from a large GPT-2 checkpoint that does not fit in 4 GiB RAM

routes.title: Reproduce GPT-2 (124M) training on OpenWebText
routes.description: Tokenizes the OpenWebText dataset and trains GPT-2 across 8 GPUs for days.
routes.reason: needs a multi-GPU A100 node and a download of tens of GB

routes.title: Check GPT-2 baseline losses on OpenWebText
routes.description: Evaluates the four released GPT-2 checkpoints on OpenWebText and prints train and validation loss.
routes.reason: needs the prepared OpenWebText dataset (about 54GB download) and GPUs for the larger models
